moments.title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Underway
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are live in Glasgow, Scotland, running until August 2nd with thousands of athletes competing across various sports.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are in full swing, bringing incredible sporting action and national pride to Scotland. Who are you backing for gold? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Scottish Talent Focus
angles.copy: Team Scotland on home turf! The Commonwealth Games are lighting up Glasgow. We're glued to every moment, cheering on our amazing athletes until Sunday. #TeamScotland

moments.title: Women's Golf Major Tees Off
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open, one of golf's five majors, is taking place at Royal Lytham & St Annes in England from July 29 to August 2.

angles.name: Golf Action
angles.copy: Major golf action this week! The AIG Women's Open is live from Royal Lytham & St Annes. Who's your pick to lift the trophy on Sunday?

angles.name: British Host
angles.copy: World-class golf on home soil! The AIG Women's Open brings the best of women's golf to Royal Lytham & St Annes. Don't miss a swing!

moments.title: Luke Combs Sells Out Wembley
moments.blurb: Country superstar Luke Combs is playing two massive, sold-out shows at London's Wembley Stadium this weekend, July 31st and August 1st.

angles.name: Concert Excitement
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is about to get a whole lot of country! Luke Combs takes the stage for two sold-out nights starting Friday. Who's going?

angles.name: London Buzz
angles.copy: London, get ready for some serious country music! Luke Combs is bringing his hits to Wembley this weekend. What a way to kick off August!

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 40

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold on to the top spot on the Official Singles Chart. Is 'Rein Me In' your summer anthem?

angles.name: New Entries & Movers

angles.copy: Celebrating a rock legend today! Rush frontman Geddy Lee turns 73. His bass lines and vocals are truly iconic. What's your ultimate Rush song?

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Patti Scialfa's birthday today! Her contributions to music, both solo and with Bruce Springsteen, are legendary. What's your favourite track featuring Patti?
